people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
translations.bsb: From Ephraim: 20,800 mighty men of valor, famous among their own clans.
translations.kjv: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
translations.asv: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers' houses.
